name: babeldub
description: AI localization and dubbing of any game: translate voice-over and text, re-voice every line in the original character's own voice with local voice-cloning TTS, repack into native engine formats.

settings.name: BabelDub home
settings.description: Folder for engine environments, model weights, tools and projects (tens of GB). Leave empty for the default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\BabelDub on Windows, ~/.local/share/babeldub on Linux.
